description: This file defines the jQuery UI Widget factory, providing a framework for creating stateful widgets with a common API. It includes widget registration, extension, method calling, and event handling functionalities.

classes.name: Widget
classes.description: Base class for all widgets, providing core widget functionalities such as options management, event handling, and lifecycle methods.

methods.name: $.widget
methods.description: Factory function to create or extend widgets with a specific name, base, and prototype.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends objects, used for merging options and prototypes.

methods.name: bridge
methods.description: Binds a widget constructor to a jQuery plugin name.

methods.name: _createWidget
methods.description: Initializes a widget instance, setting up DOM element, options, and event bindings.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the widget instance, removing event handlers and data.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Gets or sets widget options, supporting nested keys.

methods.name: _setOption
methods.description: Sets individual widget options, handling special cases like 'classes' and 'disabled'.
